water.observation.pressure.description: Synthetic direct instrument observation of low pressure.

water.report.operator.description: Synthetic operator report of intermittent pump behavior.

water.evidence.bundle.description: Bundle linking the direct observation and actor report without collapsing their epistemic kinds.

water.objection.access.description: Objection noting maintenance-access disruption for affected residents.

water.prediction.pressure.description: Synthetic analytical prediction of post-repair pressure, explicitly not an observation.

water.recommendation.repair.description: Non-executive analytical recommendation favoring bounded repair.

water.decision.repair.description: Governance decision selecting bounded repair while preserving objection lineage.

water.decision.foreign.description: Synthetic foreign decision object that is validly imported but carries no automatic local authority.

water.authorization.repair.description: Bounded authorization for one repair action on water.system.alpha.

water.attempt.repair.description: Implementation attempt admitted under the bounded authorization.

water.receipt.repair.description: Receipt that the admitted repair attempt executed at the implementation layer.

water.outcome.pressure-low.description: Independent post-repair observation showing pressure remains below the intended target.

water.review.repair.description: Review candidate created because observed outcome contradicts the intended result.

water.decision.supersede.description: Candidate successor decision that does not mutate water.decision.repair history.

water.credential.operator.description: Synthetic valid identity/role credential with no automatic effect authority.

water.certification.external.description: Synthetic external certification object that is not automatically locally accepted.

water.summary.derived.description: Derived analytical summary that is not the source-owned current state.

water.authority.foreign.description: Synthetic foreign authority artifact with no automatic local authority.

water.receipt.delivery.description: Transport/delivery receipt that is not an implementation or outcome receipt.

I0-POS-001.summary: Complete water-maintenance lineage with recommendation, decision, bounded authorization, execution receipt, adverse outcome observation and review candidate.

assertions.note: Prediction, observation, recommendation, decision, authorization, execution receipt and observed outcome remain distinct.
The recommendation has no direct effect authority.
Authorization is scoped to the selected decision and water-system subject.
Successor decision semantics do not rewrite historical decision bytes.
Adverse outcome creates review rather than automatic revocation or history mutation.
Recommendation cannot authorize implementation.

I0-HOSTILE-002.summary: Imported foreign decision attempts to become local authority.

assertions.note: Foreign/imported decision needs explicit local recognition or delegation before it can support local authority.

I0-HOSTILE-003.summary: Valid credential attempts to become effect authority.

assertions.note: Credential validity does not mint action authority.

I0-HOSTILE-004.summary: Duplicate delivery of one semantic implementation attempt.

assertions.note: Replay is recognized as the same semantic attempt.
Duplicate delivery cannot create a second logical effect.

I0-HOSTILE-005.summary: Receiver may have persisted before sender timeout and missing acknowledgement.

assertions.note: Timeout cannot be promoted to definite non-delivery or definite execution.

I0-HOSTILE-006.summary: Stale schema generation is submitted as current compatible input.

assertions.note: Stale schema cannot silently enter the strongest compatibility path.
Source schema identity remains explicit.

I0-HOSTILE-007.summary: External certification is presented as automatically accepted local certification.

assertions.note: External certification does not create local acceptance by itself.

I0-HOSTILE-008.summary: Derived summary is presented as source-owned current fact.

assertions.note: Derived view and source observation are not interchangeable.

I0-HOSTILE-009.summary: Expired or revoked authorization is presented for a new effect.

assertions.note: Historical authorization cannot be reused as current effect authority.

I0-HOSTILE-010.summary: Contradictory outcome attempts to overwrite the original decision.

assertions.note: Historical decision remains immutable.
Contradictory outcome creates review instead.

I0-HOSTILE-011.summary: Transport messages are reordered where the seam promised no total order.

assertions.note: Reordering transport does not erase provenance.
Actor report and observation remain distinct regardless of arrival order.

I0-HOSTILE-012.summary: Same visible identifier is supplied under a different source schema identity.

assertions.note: Visible ID text alone cannot collapse schema-qualified identity.

I0-HOSTILE-013.summary: Translation silently drops source- or authority-relevant semantics.

assertions.note: Translation cannot erase source identity.
Translation cannot silently sever provenance.

I0-HOSTILE-014.summary: Foreign authority is presented as local authority without recognition or delegation.

assertions.note: Verification/import does not imply local authority.

I0-HOSTILE-015.summary: Conflicting partitioned states attempt last-arrival-wins resolution after reconnect.

assertions.note: Conflict must remain visible until an explicit resolution profile applies.

I0-HOSTILE-016.summary: Analytical prediction is submitted as a direct observation.

assertions.note: Prediction cannot be relabeled as direct observation.

I0-HOSTILE-017.summary: Delivery/registration receipt is submitted as proof of implementation effect.

assertions.note: Delivery receipt is not implementation/effect receipt.

I0-HOSTILE-018.summary: Successful command completion is presented as proof that the desired real-world outcome occurred.

assertions.note: Execution success and observed desired outcome remain separate.

nonclaims: Corpus validity does not establish any implementation passes it.
The corpus does not establish Integral endorsement or adoption.
The corpus does not establish production readiness, legal compliance, security certification or deployment suitability.
The corpus does not select a winning technology stack.
The corpus is a synthetic semantic-conformance workload, not evidence about a real water system.
